trackHighlight: COP28 & COP29 Flagship Cinema · 3M+ Views World Water Day Story
highlights: Wrote, directed, and edited the flagship climate action documentary screened at the COP28 UAE Pavilion in Dubai and installed permanently at the IAEA Seibersdorf Laboratories visitor center.
Produced documentary videos, custom kinetic typography in After Effects, and multimedia feature stories (including Glaciers on Borrowed Time with 3M+ views) for COP28 and COP29.
Created social media video packages and visual content series that raised monthly impressions across joint FAO and IAEA channels by 35%.
Supervised external creative contractors, camera operators, and graphic designers under strict delivery clocks and brand standards.
